name: Crypt wall with burial niches
description: A 1.5 m section of the dark blue-grey ashlar crypt wall, 0.6 m thick and 3 m high, with two burial niches stacked in its front face under long lintel stones. The lower niche holds a body wrapped in a pale, stained linen shroud tied with cords; the upper one holds only a skull, two bones and grave dust.

provenance.prompt: A 1.5 m crypt wall section with two stacked burial niches, one holding a shrouded body: the same dark dressed ashlar as wall_crypt_straight, about 3 m high and 0.6 m thick, the niches in the front (-y) face.
